structured_output.what_is_happening: $SCAN (DevScan) is a pump.fun "utility" coin tied to devscan.org, which presents itself as a free Chrome extension that turns a dev's launch history into charts on Axiom, GMGN and Padre. The coin was created around 13:15 UTC and graduated to PumpSwap at 13:24 UTC. About 45 minutes later it hit the rule at roughly $60k market cap, with about $105k of 1-hour volume (h1 turnover ~5x) and +20-30% price moves. The DexScreener profile is paid for and 50 boosts are active. GMGN shows a heavily bot-driven trader base: 188 bundler wallets, 381 fresh wallets, 44 snipers and a 62% bot/degen rate, though 13 smart wallets are also tagged. The dev holds 0.24%, and some supply sits in Streamflow vaults.

narrative.description: The story is a trader-tool utility token: a browser extension that shows dev history for memecoin traders on Axiom, GMGN and Padre. That is a useful niche for pump.fun degens, but it is crowded: devscan.dev, devscan.tech, devscan.wtf and devscan.app all offer dev-tracking tools, and older DevScan/DEVSCAN tokens exist and are dead. This is not a cultural or news event, so attention depends on the tool itself and on paid promotion.
narrative.why_spreading: What I can see is launch momentum after graduation, amplified by paid DexScreener boosts (50) and bundler/bot volume. The only organic hook is the 'real product' angle. I found no organic posts from third parties.

token_connection.why_this_token: devscan.org names this exact contract (k1jn...pump) as $SCAN, and the DexScreener/GeckoTerminal profiles link to @devscantech.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Several copycat SCAN/DevScan tokens were launched minutes before and after this one, all now at about $3k market cap with no liquidity. SolScanner SCAN (~$293k market cap, dormant) is a different project. Older DevScan tokens ($DEV on Meteora, DEVSCAN) belong to other DevScan brands.

authenticity.evidence: 50 paid DexScreener boosts, a paid profile, 188 bundler wallets and 381 fresh wallets among about 464 GMGN-tracked holders, and a 62% bot/degen rate. The contract returns no indexed results, and I could not read the X account.
authenticity.uncertainty: X content was inaccessible (HTTP 402), so organic KOL or community traction could exist without my seeing it. The 13 smart wallets could point to some real interest.

structural_risks: About $21k of liquidity against a $61k market cap, so the pool is thin
Heavy bundler/fresh-wallet trading, which suggests wash volume and coordinated exits
The dev's prior launch count is 2 and the X account's is 4, so a serial launcher is possible
Price is already about 17% below the $79k ATH, which is within the first hour
The ~$40-50k first-hour volume is paid-boost driven and may fade once boosts expire

structured_output.counterargument: Unlike most coins in this pool, this one has a real, functional-looking product website that names this exact contract. Trader-tool tokens aimed at Axiom/GMGN users can pull in the very degen audience that trades them. The dev bought 50 boosts and has vested/locked supply in Streamflow, which shows commitment. Holder concentration is low (top 10 at 18%), and 13 smart wallets are in. A move from $60k to $130k is a common path for graduated utility coins with an active dev.
unknowns: The content of the X account and how engaged its followers are
Whether the Chrome extension is actually published and has users
Who the dev is and what their other launches did
Whether the bundler wallets are the team's

source_coverage.notes: The contract has no search index hits. devscan.org confirms the contract. x.com returned 402 and DexScreener returned 403.

structured_output.thesis: $SCAN is the canonical token for a plausible trader utility, but its attention looks mostly paid (boosts) and bot/bundler driven, in a crowded 'DevScan' niche with no visible organic spread. Doubling to about $125k within 6h is possible but below break-even odds.
